name: Dockyard Duo first release

game.arena: compact loading dock with ramp, crane and escape barge
game.art_direction: colorful isometric toy warehouse; optional user preference pending
game.magnet: bounded fixed-tick impulses through actual Box3D query/force APIs; no additional grab joint initially
game.host_loss: pause/end shared round with explicit host-left notice; retain lobby result and offer rehost/new round; no seamless authority migration claim
game.recovery: real same-identity reconnect, late receive-only observer and automatic complete Welcome after history loss

web.architecture: one Box3D engine+shim archive linked once into existing Odin/Godot AOT extension; real Core backend service/domain and ownership
web.simd: one bounded scalar vs supported Wasm SIMD comparison; select one build identity
web.deployment: deploy-ready HTTPS/WSS package and exact serving/config guide; public live URL or new paid service requires a later concrete choice
web.external_connectivity: existing Party/Room/WebRTC with ICE/TURN; direct and forced relay need actual independent-client evidence; localhost is not Internet proof

reference.power: AC power, foreground tab, no CPU throttling

evaluation_browser.name: Safari
evaluation_browser.policy: actual Safari physics/full5/multiplayer pass required before admission; WebKit emulation is separate evidence

reference.qualification: record actual versions, GPU/renderer, timer resolution, isolation and selected Wasm/tool hashes at run time; software WebGL/headless results are functional only

budgets.status: declared before browser physics measurement; any change needs reason/version and preserved results
budgets.sampling: retain every selected normal/repair sample including cold/error/outliers; no phase subtraction; capture load separately; distinguish browser wall timer resolution and background state; RSS/UA estimates are diagnostic, not Native ledger

qualification_cases: complete clean round with separate nonzero controls
full five-part authority/client byte comparison and actual eligible effects once
bounded delay/jitter/loss through real transport seam
same-token reconnect with old-scope packet isolation
actual background gaps below and beyond H128
native and minimal Kit compatibility using the shared backend
prototype_acceptance: native solo practice and two independently controlled local clients
one awkward cargo carried cooperatively to delivery sensor with exactly-once score
real hinge/contact/magnet forces; camera/meshes are presentation only
clear retry and controls; screenshot plus automated round evidence
user/two-human play feedback requested once concrete prototype exists; never label automation human feedback
fork_policy: pinned upstream plus small justified patches first; generic allocator/snapshot/platform changes only; version identities and preserve regression/provenance; no remote fork/upstream messages implied
unavailable: No browser solver/full-state/performance result at declaration
No native x86 hardware performance result
No mobile port or public live hosting established
